d: Vijay Kumar Chaudhary On Nitish Setu : nitish setu ke lokarpan karyakram men upmukhyamantri vijay chaudhri ne pul ka nam 'nitish setu' rakhe jane ke phaisle ka khule dil se svagat kiya. unhonne kaha ki desh men pahli bar bihar ne jal sansadhan vibhag ki or se gad prabandhan niti banaee hai aur bharat sarkar bhi iska phremvark taiyar kar rahi hai.
